title: Tcard_X6853-16.3.0.145SP06-OP005PF001AZ_a15
description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
X6853-16.3.0.145SP06(OP005PF001AZ)

Android Version:
1. Upgraded from Android 15 to Android 16 for enhanced security, more features, and a better user experience.

OS Version:
1. Upgraded from XOS 15.1.2 to XOS 16.3.0 for a smarter user interface and a refreshed look for your device.

AI
1. AI Suggestions: Added three types of service cards—Local, System, and Lifestyle, and optimized transition animations.
2. Enhanced AI Search: Support summary and collection search in MindHub, as well as natural language search in Settings.
3. Upgraded NMT architecture: Faster AI subtitle generation with more accurate real-time subtitle sync for video streams.

GlowSpace Superfluid Visual Language
1. Applied a translucent glass-inspired design across the system, including the lock screen, home screen, Control Center, and system controls, with smooth and immersive animations.

Wallpapers
1. Live photos to live wallpapers: Set live photos directly as home screen wallpapers.
2. AI Theme Generator: Upload a wallpaper to automatically generate a matching system theme with similar colors and style.
3. To optimize device resource usage, system stability, and the overall user experience, this version no longer supports subtly animated wallpapers. As a result, subtly animated effects will no longer play on the Lock Screen or Home Screen. If you are currently using a subtly animated wallpaper, it will revert to the default static wallpaper after the update. You can then choose and apply another wallpaper you like.

Launcher
1. Added icon visualization for app download progress.
2. Added auto folder name suggestions.
3. Widget Center now includes a featured section, with a new 1×1 One-Tap Lock Screen widget.

Notifications & Control Center
1. Applied superfluid visuals and smooth animations across the system as well as seamless status bar transitions.
2. Supported notification stacking and grouping, as well as custom grouping rules for apps.
3. Designed seamless expansion animations for Wi-Fi and mobile data cards, with support for hiding switch labels in Control Center.

Privacy & Security
1. Unlock security: Changing your password, fingerprint, or face data now requires privacy password verification.
2. Unified privacy password: Manage all privacy features with one password, with support for password reset.
3. Dual System optimization: Apps can now be transferred between systems.

Communication Network
1. Optimized hotspot power consumption to reduce heat generation and battery usage when the phone is in your pocket.
2. Enhanced call recording: Support automatic recording for selected contacts, with optimized file naming.

System Performance
1. Lightweight system service architecture: Reduced overall power consumption and improved running smoothness.
2. Upgraded junk cleanup to free up storage space more accurately.

Cloud Service
1. Fully upgraded cloud services to support more types of data backup and sync.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
